critical_code_review_comments: DashboardPage.jsx now 1078 lines — still above the 700-line guideline. Splitting FreeMembershipBand, ProfileVisibilityCard integration, and QuickStat tiles into modules would help maintainability.

server.py is 14776 lines — still a monolith; the new _notify_dashboard_report/_user_has_premium_access are neat additions but they duplicate premium-access logic that also lives in dashboard_hub._premium_access. Consider extracting a shared premium_access helper module.

Frontend nav polls inbox-badges every 90s (per request note) — for immediate UX after a reply the badge won't update until poll or route change. Consider dispatching a lightweight window event after successful reply/read to force a refetch.

GET /api/dashboard/inbox/badges + GET /api/dashboard/inbox both call _visible_messages which does a full to_list(200) scan of dashboard_messages plus a full scan of dashboard_message_reads for the user on every request. Add mongo indexes on dashboard_messages.created_at, dashboard_message_reads.user_id, and dashboard_message_replies.message_id.
reply endpoint accepts body up to 2000 chars but does not sanitize/escape — frontend renders as text (safe) but is worth documenting.

profile_view_events insert has no dedup / rate-limit — a scout refreshing a player's detail 20 times would inflate the counter. Consider unique compound index (player_user_id, viewer_id, day) or a short-window dedupe.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_iter87_dashboard_extras.py — creates disposable free + premium-simulated users via direct mongo insert (bypasses signup rate limit) and cleans up in fixture teardown. Uses per-test motor client to avoid event-loop binding issues with server.db. Safe to re-run as regression. Together with iter86 covers the full Dashboard Hub surface.
rca of the issue: N/A — all features work end-to-end. Non-issue encountered during test authoring: (1) /api/auth/signup rate-limits after ~2-3 signups per IP causing 429; workaround: direct-insert disposable users via motor + server.hash_password. (2) Reusing server.db across asyncio.run() calls raised 'attached to a different loop' errors because motor client binds lazily; workaround: helper _get_db() returns a fresh AsyncIOMotorClient per _run() invocation.
